title: Training Autoregressive Language Models on Rounded, Bounded, and Censored Numerical Labels via Exact Likelihood
abstract: arXiv:2611.02461v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Numerical labels often specify a set of possible values: a measurement is rounded, a laboratory test reports only a bound, or a program is stopped at a timeout. We introduce boundary marginalization, the first method that trains an autoregressive language model on the exact likelihood of such observations through its existing digit tokens. A fixed-width, order-preserving numeral representation groups consecutive grid values under shared digit prefixes. An interval is a union of such groups, so its exact probability and gradient follow from at most two boundary paths, the successive digit prefixes of its endpoints, each of length logarithmic in the number of grid values. The resulting objective unifies precise, rounded, bounded, and censored supervision and trains digit decisions at the resolution supplied by each observation. translated_title: 通过精确似然在舍入、有界和删失数值标签上训练自回归语言模型
translated_abstract: 数值标签通常指定一组可能的值：测量值会被舍入，实验室检测可能只报告一个界限，或者程序在超时时被中止。我们提出了边界边缘化，这是首个利用自回归语言模型现有的数字标记，在此类观测的精确似然上进行训练的方法。一种固定宽度、保序的数字表示方式将连续的网格值归入共享的数字前缀之下。一个区间是这些组的并集，因此其精确概率和梯度可由至多两条边界路径（即区间端点的逐位数字前缀）导出，每条路径的长度与网格值数量呈对数关系。由此得到的目标函数统一了精确、舍入、有界和删失等监督形式，并以每个观测所提供的分辨率来训练数字决策。相同的计算还支持精确的分布查询以及连续排序概率的无偏梯度。
tldr: 提出边界边缘化方法，首次通过精确似然让自回归语言模型在舍入、有界和删失等区间型数值标签上训练，仅用至多两条对数长度的边界路径即可计算精确概率和梯度。
en_tdlr: Introduces boundary marginalization, the first method to train autoregressive language models on exact likelihoods of rounded, bounded, and censored numerical labels, computing exact probabilities and gradients from at most two logarithmic-length boundary paths.
